name: page-template-column
description: WordPress plugin: a sortable, filterable Template column for pages, posts and custom post types.
author: Ryan Sigg

scripts.lint:php: find page-template-column.php includes bin tests -name '*.php' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l
scripts.zip: mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/page-template-column.zip && cd .. && zip -rq page-template-column/dist/page-template-column.zip page-template-column/page-template-column.php page-template-column/includes page-template-column/readme.txt page-template-column/LICENSE
